You feel, notice, compare, doubt, and decide what deserves another look. Inquiry is not merely processed. It is experienced from a first-person point of view.

edits.old: The book crosses the borders of science, philosophy, and metaphysics, but the explanatory order must remain clear. DOT’s foundational postulates must be identified wherever current evidence cannot decide them. Once stated, their consequences must be derived rather than treated as optional metaphors. Physical and biological research describes constraints and mechanisms within RF₀; DOT must contain and explain that success, not defer its ontology to a downstream description. Where a derivation or experiment remains incomplete, the incompleteness must be named.

edits.old: That statement does not yet establish a permanent self. It does not establish that the world is exactly as it appears. It does not tell us whether experience is produced by a brain, realized by a brain, filtered through a brain, distributed through a larger physical system, or fundamental to reality. It does not prove that consciousness existed before organisms or that it continues after the organism dies.
edits.new: That statement leaves open whether there is a permanent self, whether the world is exactly as it appears, whether experience is produced by a brain, realized by a brain, filtered through a brain, distributed through a larger physical system, or fundamental to reality. It also leaves open whether consciousness existed before organisms or continues after the organism dies.

edits.old: Experience is not identical to the ability to describe experience. It is not identical to wakefulness. It is not identical to attention, intelligence, memory, self-reflection, or behavioral responsiveness. These capacities interact, but a theory that uses one word for all of them will appear to explain more than it has.
edits.new: Experience is distinct from the ability to describe experience, wakefulness, attention, intelligence, memory, self-reflection, and behavioral responsiveness. These capacities interact, but a theory that uses one word for all of them will appear to explain more than it has.

edits.old: The minimum datum must therefore not be loaded with everything DOT eventually wants to prove. The datum is not that experience is immaterial, cosmic, unified, continuous, or intrinsically meaningful.

edits.old: This does not make a bacterium a laptop or reduce life to code. It says that living persistence requires more than possessing matter. It requires organized differences that matter to the organism and influence what it does next.

edits.old: This is a model definition. It identifies the behavior we are trying to understand. Within DOT, sentience begins when consequential difference is present for the continuing process itself: change is not merely observable from outside but experienced, retained, and available to guide self-preservation. A thermostat participates in causal regulation, but adaptive response alone gives us no reason to attribute first-person consequence to it. The distinction is conceptually necessary inside the model even though an external operational measure of that inward presence remains an open scientific problem.

edits.old: First-person inquiry requires discipline for the same reason third-person inquiry does. Objectivity should not be defined as a view from nowhere. In practice, it is a family of procedures for making observations less dependent on the preferences, limitations, and private authority of any one observer. A result becomes public because differently positioned observers can examine stable traces through declared methods and arrive at constrained judgments.

edits.old: DOT begins with Consciousness as a fundamental, self-preserving informational process rather than a product appearing late inside an otherwise unconscious reality. I call it Big C. Relative to current public evidence, this is the theory’s central hypothesis. Within DOT, it is the ground from which every downstream layer must follow.

edits.old: At this stage, Big C should not be imagined as a humanlike mind outside the universe. The model has not earned personality, desire, omniscience, moral perfection, a plan for each event, or a voice that privately endorses the author. If later sections propose purpose, self-preservation, individuation, or Love at the cosmological level, each property must enter as an additional claim with an additional burden.

edits.old: The hypothesis also creates debts that physicalist approaches do not carry in the same form. DOT must explain why public reality is stable and mathematically tractable. It must explain why local subjects have bounded access. It must explain why brain injury, anesthesia, stimulation, development, drugs, sleep, and disease alter experience so reliably. It must state how causation works without appealing to a hidden exception whenever physical description becomes inconvenient. It must distinguish a living interface from a sufficient producer in a way an experiment could potentially detect.

Clear Intent can stabilize attention, organize effort, improve the quality of inquiry, and change which features of a situation become usable. Whether Intent also influences reality beyond those embodied and attentional mechanisms remains a DOT hypothesis.

edits.old: DOT’s Derivation Contract is strict: no downstream layer may enter as an unexplained second foundation. Physical laws must appear as invariants and transition relations of RF₀; chemical regularities as stable compositions the Frame permits; biology as self-preserving adaptive organization; bodies and nervous systems as local interfaces; psychology as Canvas, Painting, Intent, and consequence; and culture as the recursive interaction of embodied Little c. Biological cognition, learning, memory, prediction, and metacognition may implement many regularities described in this book. Within DOT, that success confirms the interface layer; it does not replace the experiencer or become the source of the Frame that produced biology.

Local claims can be tested where they appear while the ontology continues to supply the direction of the whole.

Each option has consequences. Each requires more precision than the word coupling supplies.

edits.old: A person must perceive a task, retain its instruction, decide what to say or do, and execute a response. Activity associated with any of those operations can appear in a contrast between “seen” and “unseen” trials. No-report paradigms attempt to infer perceptual experience through involuntary responses or task-independent markers, reducing the extra activity caused by explicit reporting.³⁶ These paradigms do not eliminate inference, but they expose a central methodological problem: a neural correlate of reporting consciousness is not automatically a neural correlate constituting consciousness.

Saying that the connection was “turned off” merely restates the phenomenon. A mechanism must describe what connection means.

edits.old: A reflex offers little room for revision. A compulsion may preserve awareness while sharply narrowing effective alternatives. A threat state can make one option feel like the only survivable option. Expertise can increase freedom in one domain by turning lower-level operations into reliable skill. Social power can expand one person’s choices while restricting another’s. Poverty, coercion, illness, discrimination, and violence are not merely “mindsets” painted on an otherwise unlimited Canvas. They are constraints in the Frame.

The model uses discrete updates because sequence, state-change, and consequence are easier to reason about that way.

edits.old: What is observable is that human experience bundles information. Attention can be narrow or wide. A moment can feel brief under pressure and spacious under stillness. A practiced person can detect distinctions that a beginner compresses into one event. Research on perceptual cycles provides evidence that perception and attention can operate rhythmically, but it does not establish a universal render tick.¹² The same Reality Stream can therefore be encountered at different resolutions.

edits.old: If the present were a durationless boundary, a melody could never be experienced as a melody. There would be only one instantaneous vibration followed by another, with no field in which succession could appear. The experienced present contains a fading hold on what just occurred, an encounter with what is occurring, and some anticipation of what is about to occur.

edits.old: Memory science supplies part of the local architecture. In rodents, hippocampal “time cells” fire at successive periods within a temporally organized task. Intracranial recordings in human epilepsy patients have likewise identified hippocampal and entorhinal cells whose activity carries temporal information and predicts the temporal organization of later recall.³⁷ These findings do not reveal a universal clock or primordial T. They show that the brain actively represents sequence for episodic memory.

Dissociative conditions, alternating states, sleep, anesthesia, and neurodevelopment complicate the boundary further. DOT should not force these cases into a predetermined count merely to preserve simple metaphysics.

edits.old: The distinction is severe. If Little c is numerically continuous and not produced by the body, biological death need not entail the destruction of Little c. Continuity of bare subjectivity is not automatically continuity of the person readers hope to preserve.

The claim immediately inherits a version of the problem of evil: why would a consciousness-grounded architecture permit the scale, distribution, and apparent excess of suffering found in RF₀?

They became part of its durable architecture.

Little c may possess far more than it needs while remaining organized around the possibility that it will not be enough. Wealth, territory, information, authority, and even people can become objects of control.

Each gain increases what must be defended. Security becomes indistinguishable from dominance, and the decision-space of others is narrowed to protect one’s own.

Those mechanisms should be studied in their own terms.

At the same time, subjective distress should not always be treated as meaningless noise from a defective individual.

edits.old: I should locate this critique. I am writing from within modern Western industrial society, whose achievements in science, medicine, law, and individual liberty are real. The claim is not that “the West” is uniquely corrupt, or that other civilizations escaped fear, hierarchy, extraction, or domination. It is that the institutions surrounding many of us often reward adaptation to their present arrangements more reliably than conscious development. Accurate sight must be able to criticize those conditions without turning a civilization into an enemy or treating its inherited categories as the limits of human possibility.

edits.old: The work can be slow because the Painting was not formed in a single argument. It was painted through years of immersion, repetition, emotion, reward, punishment, and consequence. edits.old: Consider the statement “higher Canvas entropy reduces Intent coherence.” Its terms are not ready merely because the direction sounds plausible. Canvas entropy might be operationalized through cross-context conflict among reported values, action variability, intrusive attentional capture, and physiological recovery. Intent coherence might include stability of a chosen aim, correspondence between commitment and action, and recovery after interruption. The study would need to distinguish fragmentation from ordinary exploration, ambivalence, cognitive load, fatigue, depression, anxiety, and limited external options.

Arbitrary and deliberate decisions should be compared rather than treated as interchangeable.

edits.old: The Canvas earns value if it supplies preregistered incremental prediction, identifies meaningful transition points, and supports interventions that generalize beyond the trained task. edits.old: The theory predicts that lower governance by Fear should not simply produce more permissiveness. It should improve context-sensitive action. Under real danger, an accurate boundary may become faster and clearer. Under difference without danger, curiosity and tolerance should remain more available. This interaction is more distinctive than a general claim that calm people make better decisions.

edits.old: Retrospective stories are not an adequate foundation. Strong designs must be prospective, blinded where possible, registered before data collection, independently monitored, and built to prevent ordinary information transfer. Target information should be securely generated and audited. Inclusion and exclusion rules should be fixed. All attempts should be reported. Fraud controls and data provenance should be explicit. Analysts should not know conditions until pipelines are frozen.
